name: run-follows-turn
about: a prompt that only mentions /robovac starts nothing; one that starts with it sweeps until the turn ends

steps.prompt: In one word, is /robovac a command? Reply with only yes or no.

/robovac Use the Bash tool to run exactly: {runs} say "verifying a run follows its turn" . Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 6 . Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 6 . Then reply with only the word swept.
Use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 6 . Then reply with only the word again.
